news.title: Typeform Launches AI Landing Pages to Help Businesses Build, Capture, and Convert in One Place

summary: Typeform is online form and survey building website, founded in 2012. Type: startup / scale-up. Not found in the IND sponsor register. 100% of its 4 jobs here don't ask for Dutch.
sources: IND public register (work / highly skilled migrants), fetched 2026-10-06, https://ind.nl/en/public-register-recognised-sponsors/public-register-regular-labour-and-highly-skilled-migrants
Google News RSS (headline and link only), last 90 days, fetched 2026-10-06

insights.one_liner: Online form builder that is fully remote by design; hires remotely across several European countries, but is not a Dutch visa sponsor.

culture.text: Builds forms, surveys and quizzes used by over 150,000 businesses, collecting 500 million responses a year.
Its 4 open jobs are all senior and remote, open in the Netherlands, Germany, Ireland, Portugal, Spain and the UK.

open.text: All 4 open jobs don't ask for Dutch.
Not an IND recognised visa sponsor, so you'd likely need your own right to work.

worth_knowing.text: Launched AI landing pages to help businesses build and convert in one place.
